What has been checked, and what has not

The two claims worth separating on any forecasting system: whether the evidence behind a number was verified, and whether the number itself has ever been scored.

Checked+
Quotes matched to their filing71/71
Workstreams excluded for a bad citation0
Claims read169

Every quoted figure is matched back against the document it was attributed to. A workstream that cites something the filing does not say is excluded whole, not corrected. Filing dates are checked twice, once by the adapter and again by the chain, and the retrieval window for anything read from the web is bounded at the source so nothing published after the lock date can enter at all.

Not measured+

No accuracy figure on this page has been measured. There is no backtest, the weighting is asserted rather than fitted, and the ranges are the weighing step's own and have never been checked against an outcome.

For two of the three that is not an omission to be filled in later. Scoring our estimate against past results is possible from the filings. Scoring it against the Street's figure as it stood at those quarters is not, because no source available publishes what consensus was at the time. So a p10 to p90 range here is not a claim that four outcomes in five fall inside it.

What has been checked, and what has not

The two claims worth separating on any forecasting system: whether the evidence behind a number was verified, and whether the number itself has ever been scored.

Checked+
Quotes matched to their filing65/65
Workstreams excluded for a bad citation0
Claims read103

Every quoted figure is matched back against the document it was attributed to. A workstream that cites something the filing does not say is excluded whole, not corrected. Filing dates are checked twice, once by the adapter and again by the chain, and the retrieval window for anything read from the web is bounded at the source so nothing published after the lock date can enter at all.

Not measured+

No accuracy figure on this page has been measured. There is no backtest, the weighting is asserted rather than fitted, and the ranges are the weighing step's own and have never been checked against an outcome.

For two of the three that is not an omission to be filled in later. Scoring our estimate against past results is possible from the filings. Scoring it against the Street's figure as it stood at those quarters is not, because no source available publishes what consensus was at the time. So a p10 to p90 range here is not a claim that four outcomes in five fall inside it.

What has been checked, and what has not

The two claims worth separating on any forecasting system: whether the evidence behind a number was verified, and whether the number itself has ever been scored.

Checked+
Quotes matched to their filing81/81
Workstreams excluded for a bad citation0
Claims read187

Every quoted figure is matched back against the document it was attributed to. A workstream that cites something the filing does not say is excluded whole, not corrected. Filing dates are checked twice, once by the adapter and again by the chain, and the retrieval window for anything read from the web is bounded at the source so nothing published after the lock date can enter at all.

Not measured+

No accuracy figure on this page has been measured. There is no backtest, the weighting is asserted rather than fitted, and the ranges are the weighing step's own and have never been checked against an outcome.

For two of the three that is not an omission to be filled in later. Scoring our estimate against past results is possible from the filings. Scoring it against the Street's figure as it stood at those quarters is not, because no source available publishes what consensus was at the time. So a p10 to p90 range here is not a claim that four outcomes in five fall inside it.
